`corner-cuts.step.gz` (#519, #520) is `RichPenn_cutting_corners.step`, a build123d part by a draftwright
user (Jern), gzip-compressed without changing its STEP bytes, and shared here with their permission
as a public test fixture. Uncompressed SHA-256:
`2833f9eec855600bf5c0207b3421c812da5ac3120b10eefc8afe00d21472d65c`.

A 2.000 × 2.500 × 2.000 in block, designed in inches, the file in mm (50.8 × 63.5 × 50.8):

- one large planar corner cut that starts 0.500 in (12.7 mm) from the y = 0 face at 25° from
  vertical on the x = 50.8 face and is a 45° line on the top face: a compound cut, sloping on two
  axes, so no single view shows a true angle of the plane;
- a small flat parallel to it at the opposite corner, where an inclined ⌀11.993 bore breaks out
  (the bore's location is #521).
